acceptance_criteria: Member-manifest and workspace-root entrypoints for the same Cargo workspace resolve to one daemon identity and one workspace root; world stamps and sibling-member span paths stay consistent.
description: Derive daemon/session workspace identity from the actual Cargo workspace root rather than the member manifest parent so socket hashing, world stamps, and span relativization stay stable across member-manifest entrypoints.
title: Resolve true Cargo workspace root for daemon identity
